sentences.en: Wilma's mum had a charm bracelet.
sentences.zh: Wilma 妈妈有一个魅力手镯。

sentences.en: It was made of gold The bracelet had ten charms on it.
sentences.zh: 这手镯有十魅力在……上它。

sentences.en: The charms were made of gold too.
sentences.zh: 这魅力是做的黄金也。

sentences.en: "It's a beautiful bracelet," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 它是一个美丽的手镯， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Wilma's mum was washing her hands at the sink.
sentences.zh: Wilma 妈妈是洗她手在这下沉。

sentences.en: She had the bracelet on one of the charms fell off the bracelet and.
sentences.zh: 一的这魅力落下离开这手镯， 和它去向下这插头洞。

sentences.en: It went down the plug hole Wilma's Mum was very upset.
sentences.zh: Wilma 妈妈是非常使苦恼。

sentences.en: "I hope I can get the charm out of the plug hole," she said.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能得到这魅力出的这插头洞， 她说。

sentences.en: Chip ran and got his mum.
sentences.zh: Chip 跑和得到他的妈妈。

sentences.en: "She can get the charm out," he said.
sentences.zh: 她能得到这魅力出， 他说。

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: 啊唷！ 她说。

sentences.en: Mum put a plastic bowl under the sink.
sentences.zh: 妈妈放一个塑料碗在……下方这下沉。

sentences.en: Everyone got the charm out of the plastic bowl.
sentences.zh: 每个人看出的这窗户。

sentences.en: He got the charm out of the plastic bowl He looked in the bowl.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能得到这魅力出的这插头洞， 她说。

sentences.en: There's the charm said Mum Yuck, said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 有这魅力， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: "It's got dirt on it."
sentences.zh: 它是得到尘垢在……上它。

sentences.en: Wilma's mum was glad to get it back.
sentences.zh: Wilma 妈妈是高兴的到得到它回来。

sentences.en: Mum found something else Yuck, she said look what I found.
sentences.zh: 妈妈找到某物其他。 她说。

sentences.en: It was Wilf's old chewing gum What a place to stick old chewing gum said Wilma's Mum.
sentences.zh: 什么一个地方到枝条旧的咀嚼牙龈！ 说 Wilma 妈妈。

sentences.en: The children went to Biff's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们去到 Biff 卧室。

sentences.en: Wilf had three packets of chewing gum.
sentences.zh: Wilf 有三盒的咀嚼牙龈。

sentences.en: He gave some gum to Chip This is my bedroom said Biff.
sentences.zh: 他给一些牙龈到 Chip。

sentences.en: So mind where you put the old chewing gum.
sentences.zh: 这个是我的卧室， 说 Biff， 所以头脑哪里你放这旧的咀嚼牙龈。

sentences.en: Suddenly the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地， 这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: The magic took the children on a new adventure.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿这孩子们在……上一个新的冒险。

sentences.en: "I don't know what to do with my old chewing gum." The.
sentences.zh: 我不知道什么到做和……一起我的旧的咀嚼牙龈。 两个都！

sentences.en: The magic took the children back in time.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿这孩子们回来在……里时间。

sentences.en: It took them to a river.
sentences.zh: 它拿他们到一个河。

sentences.en: A boy and a girl were looking for something in the water.
sentences.zh: 一个男孩和一个女孩是看为了某物在……里这水。

sentences.en: The boy and the girl had big pans.
sentences.zh: 这男孩和这女孩有大的有柄平底锅。

sentences.en: They scooped up little stones from the river.
sentences.zh: 他们勺向上小的石块从这河。

sentences.en: Then they looked for tiny bits of gold in the bottom of the pans.
sentences.zh: 然后他们看为了极小的一小块的黄金在……里这底部的这有柄平底锅。

sentences.en: The boy and girl got angry when they saw the children.
sentences.zh: 这男孩和女孩得到生气的当……时他们看见这孩子们。

sentences.en: They didn't want them to look for gold This is our bit of river.
sentences.zh: 他们没有想要他们到看为了黄金。

sentences.en: "Go and look for gold somewhere else!"
sentences.zh: 去和看为了黄金在某处其他！

sentences.en: Wilf gave the boy and girl some gum.
sentences.zh: Wilf 给这男孩和女孩一些牙龈。

sentences.en: They hadn't seen chewing gum before.
sentences.zh: 他们没有看见咀嚼牙龈在……之前。

sentences.en: They didn't know what to do with it You just chew it said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 他们没有知道什么到做和……一起它。

sentences.en: "Chew it, but don't swallow it."
sentences.zh: 咀嚼它， 但是不吞下它。

sentences.en: The Boy was called Luke and the girl was called Alice They lived in the hut by the river Alice and Luke looked for gold every day.
sentences.zh: 这男孩是叫 Luke 和这女孩是叫 Alice。

sentences.en: It was a hard life.
sentences.zh: 它是一个困难的生命。

sentences.en: The family hadn't found any gold, and Luke and Alice were always hungry.
sentences.zh: 这家庭没有找到任何黄金， 和 Luke 和 Alice 是总是饿的。

sentences.en: "Looking for gold is hard," said Luke.
sentences.zh: 看为了黄金是困难的， 说 Luke。

sentences.en: "Do you want to help us?"
sentences.zh: 做你想要到帮助我们？

sentences.en: The children helped look for gold.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们帮助看为了黄金。

sentences.en: Wilf and Biff helped Luke's father.
sentences.zh: Wilf 和 Biff 帮助 Luke's 爸爸。

sentences.en: Wilma and Chip helped Alice and Luke.
sentences.zh: Wilma 和 Chip 帮助 Alice 和 Luke。

sentences.en: "I'm glad I brought the gum," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 我带来这牙龈， 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: "This is hard work."
sentences.zh: 这个是困难的工作。

sentences.en: It was cold in the river and the children soon got tired We do this every day said Luke and we still haven't found any gold.
sentences.zh: 我们做这个每个一天， 说 Luke， 和我们仍然没有找到任何黄金。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Luke's father shouted.
sentences.zh: 突然地， Luke's 爸爸喊。

sentences.en: "Gold!" He yelled.
sentences.zh: 好的。 黄金！ 他叫喊。

sentences.en: We found gold!
sentences.zh: 我们已经找到黄金。

sentences.en: He picked up a big nugget of gold and jumped up and down.
sentences.zh: 他挑选向上一个大的天然贵重金属块的黄金和跳向上和向下。

sentences.en: Everyone ran to see.
sentences.zh: 每个人跑到看见。

sentences.en: Everyone looked at the gold nugget.
sentences.zh: 每个人看在这黄金天然贵重金属块。

sentences.en: It felt heavy and cold.
sentences.zh: 它感觉重的和冷的。 喊 Luke's 妈妈。

sentences.en: "Hooray!" Shouted Luke's mother.
sentences.zh: 这食物是准备好的。 它感觉重的和冷的。 喊 Luke's 妈妈。

sentences.en: We found gold! Shouted Luke's mother.
sentences.zh: 我们已经找到黄金。 它感觉重的和冷的。 喊 Luke's 妈妈。

sentences.en: We have found gold at last.
sentences.zh: 我们有找到黄金在最后的， 她说。

sentences.en: She said I thought we'd never find any.
sentences.zh: 我想 we'd 从不找到任何。

sentences.en: The children went to town with Luke's mother and father Luke and Alice were excited We can sell the gold they said and we can buy some food.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们去到城镇和……一起 Luke's 妈妈和爸爸。

sentences.en: We can buy new clothes said Luke's mother and a new spade Said Luke's father and some chewing gum said Luke.
sentences.zh: 我们能买新的衣服， 说 Luke's 妈妈。

sentences.en: "What's chewing gum?" Asked Luke's father.
sentences.zh: 它是 Wilf 旧的咀嚼牙龈。 哦不！ 说 Luke's 爸爸。

sentences.en: Some men were waiting in the road.
sentences.zh: 一些男人们是等在……里这路。

sentences.en: Oh, no Said Luke's father robbers.
sentences.zh: 哦不！ 说 Luke's 爸爸。

sentences.en: They will steal our gold nugget.
sentences.zh: 他们将偷我们的黄金天然贵重金属块。

sentences.en: What shall we do?"
sentences.zh: 什么将我们做？

sentences.en: Wilf had an idea.
sentences.zh: Wilf 有一个主意。

sentences.en: He spoke to all the children.
sentences.zh: 他说到全部这孩子们。

sentences.en: Give me your chewing gum He said give me all the old chewing gum and give me the gold nugget.
sentences.zh: 给我全部这旧的咀嚼牙龈， 和给我这黄金天然贵重金属块。

sentences.en: The robbers wanted gold and money.
sentences.zh: 这强盗想要黄金和钱。

sentences.en: "But we're just a poor family," said Luke's father.
sentences.zh: 但是我们是刚刚一个贫穷的家庭， 说 Luke's 爸爸。

sentences.en: We haven't got any money and we haven't found any gold The robbers looked everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我们没有得到任何钱和我们没有找到任何黄金。

sentences.en: They searched everyone We're only children said Alice.
sentences.zh: 我们是只有孩子们， 说 Alice。

sentences.en: "We haven't got any gold and we haven't got any money."
sentences.zh: 我们没有得到任何黄金和我们没有得到任何钱。

sentences.en: The robbers couldn't find the gold they let everyone go.
sentences.zh: 这强盗不能找到这黄金。

sentences.en: "Hooray," said Luke.
sentences.zh: 好耶， 说 Luke。

sentences.en: "Wilf's chewing gum saved the gold."
sentences.zh: Wilf 咀嚼牙龈挽救这黄金。

sentences.en: "Is that chewing gum?"
sentences.zh: 是那个咀嚼牙龈？ 问 Luke's 爸爸。

sentences.en: Asked Luke's father Luke's father and mother got some money for the gold I can have a new dress said Alice and I can have new boots said Luke.
Luke's father bought a new cart.
sentences.zh: ~ 美国兵 GROCERIE WHOLESA 零售 Luke's 爸爸买一个新的大车。

sentences.en: It was bigger than the old one We made a new cart said Luke.
sentences.zh: 它是大的比这旧的一。

sentences.en: "There is so much to take home."
sentences.zh: 那里是所以许多到拿家。

sentences.en: The children helped them put everything on the cart.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们帮助他们放一切在……上这大车。

sentences.en: "This is hard work too," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 这个是困难的工作也， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "These magic adventures are not all fun."
sentences.zh: 这些魔法冒险是不全部乐趣。

sentences.en: They all went back to the river.
sentences.zh: 他们全部去回来到这河。

sentences.en: The family put on the new clothes Wilma and Biff looked for gold.
sentences.zh: 这家庭放在……上这新的衣服。

sentences.en: "I hope we find some," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们找到一些， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: "T'd love to find a gold nugget."
sentences.zh: T'd 爱到找到一个黄金天然贵重金属块。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Biff saw a little yellow speck in the pan.
sentences.zh: 突然地， Biff 看见一个小的黄色的斑点在……里这扳。

sentences.en: She had found some gold.
sentences.zh: 她有找到一些黄金。

sentences.en: "It's very small," she said.
sentences.zh: 它是非常小的， 她说。

sentences.en: Just then, the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 刚刚然后这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: The magic took the children home Biff looked at the gold.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿这孩子们到一个时间长的以前。

sentences.en: "It looks really tiny, now," she said.
sentences.zh: 它看真的极小的， 现在， 她说。

sentences.en: It looks like a speck of dust suddenly Chip sneezed.
sentences.zh: 它看喜欢一个斑点的灰尘！

sentences.en: The speck of gold blew out of Biff's hand.
sentences.zh: 这斑点的黄金 blew 出的 Biff 手。

sentences.en: It blew onto the carpet Did you see where it went? Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 它 blew 在……上到这地毯。 谁是你？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: Oh, no, sorry, said Chip.
sentences.zh: 对不起！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: The children looked and looked.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们看和看。

sentences.en: They couldn't find the little speck of gold I don't think we ever will, said Biff.
sentences.zh: 他们不能找到这小的斑点的黄金。

sentences.en: "Oh no!" Said everyone.
sentences.zh: 哦不！ Gran， 说每个人。
